exposure: normal maternal and fetal Doppler values
cohort: 313 singleton SGA fetuses and 313 appropriate-for-gestational-age control fetuses born between 34 and 42 weeks' gestation
finding: Antenatal recognition of SGA fetuses delivered after 34 weeks' gestation might improve perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Recognized and unrecognized SGA fetuses were born significantly more frequently by cesarean delivery compared to controls.
